messages:
sara: Heads-up — we want to run the tenant_uuid backfill + small index add tonight in the 23:30 UTC change window. ~30k rows estimated, low write rate but touch on the users table. will do canary -> ramp if OK.
ken: Does the index add need an exclusive lock?
sara: No exclusive DDL, it's a nullable col fill + concurrent index. job is idempotent. snippet: ```sql
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN tenant_uuid uuid; -- no lock if ADD COLUMN NULLABLE
-- backfill in batches: UPDATE users SET tenant_uuid = gen_random_uuid() WHERE tenant_uuid IS NULL LIMIT 1000;
COMMIT;
```
deploybot: deploybot: migration job created: migrations/1990012345-tenant-uuid-backfill. Scheduled 1990012345 -> 1990015900. NOTE: will auto-pin service version to release-9.2 if run.
mike: pinning to release-9.2 ok? any client compatibility concerns?
sara: release-9.2 includes the API change that surfaces tenant_uuid but is backwards-compatible. we'll pin only for the migration window then unpin.
priya: propose canary on 1% of write traffic (random sample) for 15m, monitor DB locks, p95 write latency, and error rate. abort if p95 increases >2x or rate errors +1% absolute. :warning:
joel: add a healthcheck: query for locking sessions, and a metric for rows-processed/min. If rows drop unexpectedly for >5m treat as stuck and abort.
ken: rollback criteria? what are easy escape hatches?
sara: escape hatch: cancel job (deploybot abort), remove feature-flag (feature.gate.tenant_uuid=false) which makes new code ignore tenant_uuid. if we see deadlocks or significant replica lag > 30s we abort immediately.
priya: recommend we also set a DB throttle config on the backfill: `--rate 500 qps` and soft stop on >20% replica lag.
mike: can someone draft the release note blurb? I'll publish to release-notes channel after merge.
sara: draft: "Add tenant_uuid column and backfill for multi-tenant support. Rolled out via staged canary; no breaking client changes. Admin ops: monitor DB p95, replica lag; abort if thresholds exceeded."
deploybot: deploybot: reminder: when you run migrations/1990012345 ensure deploybot flag `--pin=release-9.2` is set. To abort: `deploybot cancel 1990012345`.
joel: runbook checklist before kick: 1) smoke canary on staging, 2) create rollback PR for code that reads tenant_uuid, 3) set pager on oncall for window, 4) confirm replica lag alert is active.
ken: I'm on canary watch from 23:25–00:10 UTC. priya on metrics. mike on release notes. sara will run the job.
sara: ok starting staging smoke now, will report back in 20m. :white_check_mark:
priya: acknowledged, will wire alerts and dashboard. :thumbsup:
mike: I'll draft release note and post before 23:00 UTC.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled job 1990012345 queued. Awaiting run command.
sara: final: run at 23:30 UTC, canary 1% for 15m, ramp to 30% for 15m, full run if metrics green. abort conditions documented above. any objections?
ken: none from me.
joel: no objections.
priya: none.
mike: :thumbsup:
sara: thanks — will ping here when canary starts and when we hit ramp.
